label: 2023 Asian Women's Volleyball Championship - 22nd edition
source: BUILT from cited bytes under WO-VB-4 (PLAN-VB + CENSUS-VB-4). Capture: Wikipedia edition-page wikitext (action=raw); per-row sources = official AVC Daily Bulletins No2-No8 (SEVEN distinct day-level PDFs - this page carries NO per-match ids, granularity disclosed on every row; standings source live.app.fivb.com tournament 1410); infobox official matches=43 == built count (18 prelim + 12 classification-pool + 13 final-round). 22nd Asian Championship, 14 teams, Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand (Korat Chatchai Hall + MCC Hall), 30 Aug - 6 Sep 2023; mixed pool sizes (two 3-team + two 4-team prelim pools; E-H classification pools carry over prelim results). FIDELITY CATCH - WIKITEXT STANDINGS TYPO FOUND AND CORRECTED WITH PROOF: Pool E prints spw_THA=238 but recomputation forces 248 - with 238 the pool's spw sum (898) fails to equal its spl sum (908), while ALL other seven E-entries and Thailand's own spl=198 recompute byte-exact; corrected value used, defect documented here and in SP comments. All other 7 pools: recomputed == printed exactly (26 team-entries clean + 1 corrected = 27 sealed incl. carry arithmetic). Spine exact: SF == E/F top-2 {THA,VIE,CHN,JPN}; F == SF winners; 3P == SF losers. Champions THAILAND - 3rd title ON HOME SOIL, UNDEFEATED (MVP Chatchu-on Moksri, best setter Pornpun Guedpard) d. China 3-2 in a 16-14-fifth-set final before 5,000 at Korat Chatchai Hall; Japan bronze 3-2 over VIETNAM (best-ever 4th - and the store already documents where that 4th place led: Thailand's WCh-2025 host berth passed the continental spot DOWN TO VIETNAM, whose WCh debut is in the store's World_Championship_W/2025 edition - byte-cited both ends); host home flags all THA rows. New canon first-write: Mongolia (team ledger 69).
